title: Integrate the remaining macOS fixes from origin/macos_fix
outcome: Integrate the remaining macOS fixes from origin/macos_fix
acceptance: The setup Git path query resolves relative git rev-parse output against the queried repository root, not the CLI process's working directory, as in Greg's commit bdc1c7b on origin/macos_fix; a test runs the separate-Git-directory setup case from a different working directory.

The task_sync_setup_cli fixtures isolate Git's global configuration through HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME as well as GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL, and Git failures in the fixture report the arguments and exit status, as in bdc1c7b.

bdc1c7b's #[allow(clippy::unnecessary_wraps)] attributes and its open_unresolved test changes are not taken: master fixes those through w-154b5337dc2c (no #[allow], Greg #1281) and w-c53639903542 (fixtures derive the host default).

The full gate passes on Windows; macOS validation of the master commit that contains this change is owned by w-6224586d6418, which is ordered after this item and is not evidence this item must show; origin/macos_fix is a read-only reference and is never merged, reset or pushed (Greg, Engram::Advisor 2026-10-12 #1297).

completion.summary: Integrated the remaining macOS Git-path and fixture fixes. Git paths resolve against the queried repository; outside-directory regression and isolated Git config fixtures pass. Landed, installed, and pushed the validated two-file change; native macOS validation is owned by the subsequent item.
